ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RM-5,
Residential Multi-Unit Districts and indications as shown on Map No. 7-I in the area
bound by:

      West Albany Avenue; the alley next east of and parallel to North Kedzie Boulevard; a
      line 250 feet north of and parallel to West Fullerton Avenue; and North Kedzie
      Boulevard,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit Districts.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                         ____________________________
                                                         Carlos Ramirez-Rosa
                                                         Alderman, 35th Ward




Common Address:
2425-37 North Kedzie Boulevard
2476-80 North Albany Avenue
